root_cause.text: Three new counter enum values were placed after the BNXT_RE_OUT_OF_SEQ_ERR boundary in the enum, causing the hardware statistics buffer allocated based on BNXT_RE_NUM_STD_COUNTERS (which counts only up to that boundary) to be too small, leading to an out-of-bounds write in bnxt_re_copy_err_stats().
root_cause.evidence: The patch moves BNXT_RE_REQ_CQE_ERROR, BNXT_RE_RESP_CQE_ERROR, and BNXT_RE_RESP_REMOTE_ACCESS_ERRS before BNXT_RE_OUT_OF_SEQ_ERR in the enum. The CVE description explicitly states that "BNXT_RE_OUT_OF_SEQ_ERR acts as a boundary marker for allocating hardware statistics ... As a result, BNXT_RE_NUM_STD_COUNTERS are used when allocating hw_stats, which leads to an out-of-bounds write."
